notes.subject: גם...גם...גם
notes.rationale: Tupela/tripela 'גם' i tanim olgeta man — yu, pikinini bilong yu, pikinini bilong pikinini bilong yu — rereples i strongpela long Hibru, na Tok Pisin i holim wantaim 'wantaim' tripela taim.

notes.subject: bosim
notes.rationale: משל em i 'olsem king i bosim' — Tok Pisin 'bosim' i holim pasin bilong king, tasol 'king' bilong buk i tok moa klostu.

notes.subject: ol man bilong Yisrael i tokim Gideon
notes.rationale: Tanim tok i go stret long Gideon, na ol i askim em long bosim ol.

translation: Ol man bilong Yisrael i tokim Gideon: Yu, wantaim pikinini bilong yu, wantaim pikinini bilong pikinini bilong yu — yumi mas bosim ⟨i⟩ olgeta bilong yumi, bilong wanem yu pulap long olgeta bilong yumi i kamap gut long han bilong Midian.

tokens.gloss: yu pulap long olgeta bilong yumi i kamap gut
